scientific_integrity: All-parameter and infinite-time statements follow from a symbolic nonnegative affine-height increment and summation arguments. The standalone program checks finitely many exact-rational identities, not mathematical independence. No external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the one-square three-dimensional Hénon family with 0<delta<1 is analyzed. Above the fold all forward trajectories are unbounded, and have the stated rigorous linear lower escape-rate bound, but no exact asymptotic escape speed is claimed. At the fold convergence is asserted only for bounded future orbits. Below the fold only fixed-point existence and a stationary moment identity are claimed. Historical priority is not independently established.
title: Sharp compact-recurrence fold and finite exit budget in a three-dimensional Hénon map
